description: Intent i006 (drm-userif-divisor, snapshot s01) complete. Three credible variants of the seed's wrapped-zero-divisor mechanism found, all reachable from the hwmon fan1_target sysfs store (amdgpu_pm.c:2845 kstrtou32 -> amdgpu_dpm_set_fan_speed_rpm, dispatchers reject only U32_MAX): (1) drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c:1217 high confidence — smu_v11_0_set_fan_speed_rpm checks only 'if (speed == 0)' (line 1207) on the raw input, then divides tach_period = 60 * crystal_clock_freq * 10000 / (8 * speed) in u32; for speed in {0x20000000, 0x40000000, 0x60000000} (nonzero, != U32_MAX) the product wraps mod 2^32 to 0, giving a kernel divide-by-zero oops during CG_TACH_CTRL TARGET_PERIOD programming; registered for Navi10/Navi14 (navi10_ppt.c:3589) and Sienna Cichlid (sienna_cichlid_ppt.c:3199). (2) drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/vega20_thermal.c:204 high confidence — vega20_fan_ctrl_set_fan_speed_rpm validates only '!speed' (line 194), no min/max limits at all, before the identical '(8 * speed)' divisor (registered vega20_hwmgr.c:4433 via pp_dpm_set_fan_speed_rpm, amd_powerplay.c:581 rejects only U32_MAX). (3) drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/smu7_thermal.c:280 medium confidence — seed-identical raw-input-only check set (speed==0 plus firmware u8-derived ulMin/ulMaxRPM, process_pptables_v1_0.c:934-936, max 25500) before '/ (8 * speed)'; wrap reachable when VBIOS fan RPM limits are zeroed while fan/tach present. Siblings arcturus_ppt.c:1269 and smu_v13_0.c:1229 in the same snapshot carry the upstream '(!speed || speed > UINT_MAX/8)' guard, proving the gap is genuine. Negative evidence: amdgpu legacy si_dpm.c:6722 and radeon si_dpm.c:6199/ci_dpm.c:1172 are inside #if 0 dead blocks; smu7/vega10 OD input scaling (input[i+1]*100) is re-validated and never used as a divisor; sclk/mclk OD DIV_ROUND_UP divides by firmware golden values with the user value in the numerator; navi10 od_edit range-checks all inputs. The seed site itself (vega10_thermal.c:320) is unfixed in s01 but excluded from findings as the seed demonstration. Limitations: source-reading verification only (no hardware/compile reproducer; wrap proven arithmetically and by guard comparison), reachability requires root-owned 0644 hwmon node plus manual fan mode, smu7/vega10 wraps are firmware-limit gated, and non-fan DRM ioctl surfaces were only keyword-scanned. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i006.json (3 findings, 12 candidates, snapshots_checked=["s01"]).
